data.one_liner: Auto-generated client libraries for accessing Google APIs.
data.what_it_does: Provides automatically generated client libraries to access various Google APIs described through the API discovery service. It supports making requests to services like Google Cloud, AdMob, Android Publisher, and many others directly from Dart code.
use_when: You need to access Google APIs from a Dart or Flutter application.
You want pre-built, typed client libraries for specific Google services instead of writing raw HTTP requests.
avoid_when: You are using services like Firestore, Cloud Functions, or Storage where newer standalone google_cloud_* packages are recommended.
You only need generic HTTP requests without interacting with Google APIs.
strengths: Covers a massive variety of Google APIs out of the box.
Provides strongly-typed models and methods for Google services.
weaknesses: Some older APIs are being deprecated in favor of newer standalone Google Cloud packages.
Library size can be large due to the sheer volume of generated API clients.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and authenticate requests using OAuth2 tokens.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: For general REST API requests with advanced interceptors and features instead of auto-generated Google API clients.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer making lightweight, manual HTTP requests to Google REST endpoints rather than using large generated client libraries.

data.minimal_example:
import 'package:googleapis/abusiveexperiencereport/v1.dart' as abusiveexperiencereport;
